Subject: Claim Decision Regarding {CLAIM_NUMBER}

Dear {CLAIMANT_NAME},

We are writing to inform you that your claim for collision damage has been denied.

This decision was reached because the photos provided show a different vehicle than the one insured, and the damage could not be verified. Your policy includes the following coverage: "[COLL-1] We will pay for direct and accidental loss to your covered auto caused by collision, minus the collision deductible shown in the Declarations."

If you disagree, you may ask for a review by replying to this letter within 30 days with any additional information.

Please contact us if you have any questions regarding this letter.

ClaimPilot Claims Team
